name: ASHA Village Visit
description: An attended 60-second check-in at the start of a household or village visit. The sponsor pays per verified visit, not per self-reported one.
steps: Open PRESENCE when the visit starts
Answer the presence check in each 10-second window (6 total)
Keep PRESENCE in the foreground until the final checkpoint
why: Field incentives are paid per reported activity. One Seeker, one attended check-in a day, proven on-chain, replaces a claim nobody can audit.

name: Cold-Chain Handover
description: A driver attests an attended 60-second stop with the consignment at a handover. Up to 3 handovers a day.
steps: Open PRESENCE at the handover point
Answer the presence check in each 10-second window (6 total)
Stay with the session until the final checkpoint
why: Unattended stops are where cold chains break. Each handover leaves a device-bound, server-timed attestation. Temperature-logger hashes are a planned checkpoint field.
